svg.text: The request path: client to a private GCP origin
Six stages, each answering a different question; walk them in order when something breaks
6 · return path: response retraces the same tunnel
DNS returns the VIP; routing selects
an RE. The origin never sees the
Decides HOW to reach the site
RE tunnel ends on the SLO; the CE
forwards inward from its SLI address
name does not resolve, or resolves
HTTP 403 with a support ID from
check: site status SLO / SLI UP
Debugging rule: failures surface one stage EARLY
a dead origin looks like a site problem, a dead site looks like a load-balancer problem — name the symptom, then walk stages 1 → 6
Two XC-specific checkpoints sit on top of the usual four-question loop: the WAF at the edge and the tunnel to the site.
Resolution (stage 1) · Routing (2/4/5) · Policy (3/5) · Application (origin) — the same method you used in the packet-tracer labs.
